verified.value: Merged with four merger fixes. (1) run() had `self._last_msg = txt` in a plain function: every message raised NameError, was treated as a dropped connection, and the recorder would have reconnected forever without writing a line. (2) No __main__ block, so `python -m src.exec_host.recorder` under systemd would import and exit every 15 s. (3) The roster was only topped up to 30 coins after 24 h; now at start too. (4) recv had no timeout and nothing kept the socket alive: recv now times out at 30 s (reconnect) and a {method: ping} goes out every 30 s. Four of the lane's own tests depended on the test machine's free disk (red with 4 GB free); they now inject the floor, and a new test pins the entry point (no stray self, roster at start, ping, __main__). install.sh installs and starts the unit.
